name: Snap

L3.dsaDepth: Heavy - straightforward DSA-pattern rounds, no system design yet
rounds: Onsite: 3 rounds, all DSA-focused (~3 hours total)
extraTopics: Standard LeetCode-style DSA patterns - reports describe this level’s loop as "pretty straightforward"

L4 and Senior (L5+).dsaDepth: Heavy - fully centralized loop (team matching happens after, not before), with dedicated "Decider" interviewers evaluating culture fit throughout every round rather than in one dedicated round
rounds: Technical phone screen (~1 hr): DSA via HackerRank, occasional light behavioral questions

Onsite (~6 hrs, 6 rounds): 4 coding rounds (speed matters as much as a working solution), 1 system design round tied to an actual Snapchat feature/product, a Q&A session - some reports add a lunch/culture conversation and a round with an Engineering Director
extraTopics: Snap’s "Decider" interviewers (Snap’s equivalent of Amazon’s Bar Raiser) evaluate against 3 values: "We are Kind", "We are Smart", "We are Creative" - spread across every round, not one dedicated behavioral interview
System design tied to real Snapchat products (e.g. a messaging recommendation system, a Snapchat feature interface) rather than a generic prompt
L4 and Senior (L5+).notes: Interviews are held in a separate building from where engineers actually work, for feature-privacy reasons - several candidates note this limits getting a feel for the culture.
